action_items: Backend suite has no API tests configured (pytest reported no tests); this briefing's acceptance criteria are purely visual/CSS (hero image crop, testimonial card spacing) with no API surface, so no new backend test file was needed.

checks.criterion: A arte do hero mostra somente o símbolo colorido, sem a parte escrita 'educação do movimento' da imagem original
checks.name: hero-image-symbol-only
checks.evidence: hero-image-frame has overflow:hidden and hero-image is rendered enlarged (height >= 95% of frame height with a CSS transform applied), pushing the lower lettering portion of the original artwork out of the visible crop. Screenshot confirms only the colored symbol is visible in the hero.

checks.criterion: Os textos dos três cards da seção Histórias reais não se sobrepõem
checks.name: testimonial-cards-no-overlap
checks.evidence: For testimonial-proof-0/1/2, each card's title and 'Princípio EdMovimento' label bounding boxes are fully inside the card, and the label's top y is >= the title's bottom y (no vertical overlap) for all three cards. Screenshot confirms clear visual separation.

checks.criterion: A landing page permanece funcional após os ajustes visuais
checks.name: landing-page-functional-after-tweaks
checks.evidence: Hero image, nav-about-link click (navigated to #sobre), all three testimonial-proof cards, checklist item, and contact-location-value all rendered visible; zero HTTP responses >= 400 and zero page errors captured during the flow.
